sources_read: rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 49 (check 48) and Internal Quality Checks row 49 (check 48; no extra annotation or cell comment on that row)
rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/app_context.md and the five template prompt.md files (diffed against the task)
task/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py, task/tests/test.sh (port, health and restart lines), task/tests/Dockerfile (Playwright MCP pin), task/solution/app/server.js and src/app.tsx (name, health route)
evidence: Source review of all five prompts plus the injected app_context; no configured judge run exists for these bytes, so run_verdict stays NOT EXERCISED. Residue: none. Every template placeholder is replaced (app_context.md:3 'Name: Colderwater playground', :10 'None. The app has no sign-in', :14 one workspace at /); the diff against the template shows the sign-in gate leg, forged-request rules, tenant/data-isolation wording and multi-screen/theme review plan were all removed. A grep of tests/ for other product names, accounts, passwords, CHANGE_ME/TODO found nothing. Accuracy against the brief: all five prompts open 'the live Colderwater playground at http://localhost:3000' (line 1 of each), matching integration.md:3 (0.0.0.0:3000, workspace at /, GET /api/health) and policy.md:3/overview.md:3 (no accounts). Key screens (app_context.md:14) list exactly the controls ui.md:17 and ui.md:9-15 ask for; entities (snippet title, .js/.html filename, source, revisions) match overview.md:3. Cross-references resolve: constraints/prompt.md:5 'the second criterion' is cw_shared_saved_record (gates/constraints/judge.toml:27-32), which does ask for storage clearing; functional/prompt.md:31 restart_app on the 'verifier' server matches functional/judge.toml:14-18, restart_mcp.py:14 and its 'restart complete' reply, and exactly one criterion names it (cw_save_reload_restart); functional/prompt.md:20,22 'two uses named in the application notes' match app_context.md:25-26, with replay requested only by cw_history_restore_retry and storage clearing only by cw_save_reload_restart and cw_shared_saved_record; app_context.md:24 'One criterion also uses a public https address' is cw_preview_isolation only. The scored global gate (functional/polish/visual prompt.md:5) is the same load-and-type check as the render gate criterion (gates/render/judge.toml:23). 'each ends with the conditions under which it fails' holds: all 42 functional, 6 polish and 3 gate criteria contain 'Fails if'. visual/prompt.md:12 'ten-line JavaScript draft' matches visual/judge.toml:24; the 0-5 statement at visual/prompt.md:7 matches the anchors. Golden agrees with the description (server.js:12 health route; title 'Colderwater Playground'). Two non-blocking wording observations, neither a residue nor a mis-description: (a) app_context.md:26 'Script may be used for exactly two things' reads, in isolation, stricter than the prompts that explicitly allow read-only DOM/computed-style inspection (constraints/prompt.md:5, functional/prompt.md:20, polish/prompt.md:17, visual/prompt.md:18); the same sentence continues 'Every other graded action...' and each prompt forbids only changing DOM or state, so the intended reading is recoverable. (b) functional/prompt.md:27 'Judge behavior, not styling' sits beside two colouring criteria (cw_js_semantic_coloring, cw_html_semantic_coloring) that inspect visible styles; the criteria are explicit, so the conflict is only superficial. Broken-app probe: an app with accounts or a different screen set gains nothing from these prompts; conforming-alternative probe: an app with different labels/layout is protected by 'match controls by purpose and label' and by app_context not naming routes other than / and /api/health, both public requirements.
suggested_fix: Optional, not required for this row: reword app_context.md:26 to 'Script may change the page or send requests for exactly two things ...; read-only inspection of the rendered DOM and computed styles is not limited', and change functional/prompt.md:27 to 'Judge behavior, not visual taste'. Any such edit creates a new candidate.
